crossRefs.note: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
For Yahweh’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the maker of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance…
“Yahweh is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”
On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.

crossRefs.note: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”
For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.
For the king trusts in Yahweh. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.
He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’ ”
I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,
Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
Yahweh will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.
Yahweh has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.
I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.
I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”
“Behold, my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights: I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring…
Therefore I will give him a portion with the great. He will divide the plunder with the strong; because he poured out…
This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.
God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.
For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

translations.web: Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
translations.bsb: The LORD is my chosen portion and my cup; You have made my lot secure.
translations.kjv: The LORD is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.
translations.asv: Jehovah is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: Thou maintainest my lot.
